# opnsense_crowdsec_settings (Resource)

CrowdSec settings (**Services ▸ CrowdSec ▸ Settings**, plugin `os-crowdsec`): security engine, local API, firewall bouncer and console enrollment. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `crowdsec_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_crowdsec_settings.this
  id = "crowdsec_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_crowdsec_settings" "this" {
  agent_enabled            = true
  lapi_enabled             = true
  firewall_bouncer_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable the CrowdSec agent. Keep this enabled to detect attacks and receive alerts from the CrowSec central service.
- `crowdsec_firewall_verbose` (Boolean) Verbose /var/log/crowdsec/crowdsec-firewall-bouncer.log. Enable this for debugging.
- `enroll_key` (String, Sensitive) Click "Enroll command" on the the website and copy the key here.
- `firewall_bouncer_enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable the remediation component. Keep this enabled to block packets from the attacking IP addresses.
- `lapi_enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable the CrowdSec Local API. Keep this enabled unless you connect to a LAPI on another machine.
- `lapi_listen_address` (String) Where to listen for LAPI connections: IP address. The default value is 127.0.0.1. You can change it to a LAN address to connect from other agents/machines and bouncers. This is written in /usr/local/etc/crowdsec/config.yaml, local_api_credentials.yaml and bouncers/crowdsec-firewall-bouncer.yaml. To enable TLS, add the certificate information to config.yaml and change http to https in the other two files. Comments in YAML will not be preserved.
- `lapi_listen_port` (Number) Where to listen for LAPI connections: port. The default value is 8080, but you can change it to avoid conflicts with existing services. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `lapi_manual_configuration` (Boolean) Avoid overwriting LAPI settings for config.yaml, local_api_credentials.yaml, crowdsec-firewall-bouncer.yaml. The next two configuration options (lapi_listen_address, lapi_listen_port) will be ignored. Allows unsupported configurations like linking together multiple opnsense instances or connecting to an existing crowdsec multi-server setup.
- `rules_enabled` (Boolean) Generate block rules from the Crowdsec blocklists. They are applied to all interfaces, ipv4/v6, ingress and egress. If you disable this, you'll have to write your own rules to block anything.
- `rules_log` (Boolean) Enable log collection for CrowdSec's block rules.
- `rules_tag` (String) Add a tag to packets that are dropped by CrowdSec rules for diagnostic purposes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `crowdsec_settings`.
